question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing benchwarmer, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing goalkeeper, and Eve is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) benchwarmer
(C) right midfielder
(D) goalkeeper
(E) right winger
solution:
Positions in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve).
Initial: (center midfielder, benchwarmer, right midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger)
1. Dave ↔ Alice: (goalkeeper, benchwarmer, right midfielder, center midfielder, right winger)
2. Bob ↔ Eve: (goalkeeper, right winger, right midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer)
3. Bob ↔ Alice: (right winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder, center midfielder, benchwarmer)
4. Claire ↔ Alice: (right midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger, center midfielder, benchwarmer)
5. Alice ↔ Eve: (benchwarmer, goalkeeper, right winger, center midfielder, right midfielder)
Bob is playing goalkeeper, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
